strings.en: I have awakened. To fulfill my mission.
I shall fulfill my mission.
I shall sever the chain of light and darkness.
The great battle... The victor shall be me.
My teaching is, in other words, closing the eyes.
There is no need to govern you./　For you shall vanish here.
Death and calamity to the fools/　who break the Seven Precepts.
That great strength and great will/　shall summon a new calamity...
To think you are the seeds of might...
The great battle.../　Its outcome shall never change...
The chain of light and darkness/　must be severed here...
To bring silence to the universe...
The growth of the seven thoughts must be stopped...
You shall atone for the sin/　of the ancients who used me.
The sin of twisting my teachings/　cannot be forgiven.
Holder of the key... One who may hold it... Disperse.
I will not permit you to take the key.
You shall not be allowed to reach the Gate of Truth.
A karma born again.../　I shall sever the chain of causality.
I shall sever the bonds of a past life.
Those who seek profound wisdom must be annihilated.
Servant of the Kaimei Brain, vanish at once.
A sage who aids fools is the height of folly.
Have you forgotten your mission as a Hakam?
I will not permit rebellion.
The seeds of calamity must be plucked.
I shall sever the cycle of negativity.
Cast away your defiance and bow your head.
I shall sever the chain of negativity.
Ignorant fools must die.
You have no need of teaching.
My conclusion shall not change...!
Daaaaaaarkness...!!
I sense malice... It must be erased swiftly.
An empty protest.
Your fate shall not change.
Your rebuttal is absurd.
I must finish this before/　the seven thoughts swell.
Know your limits.
Even the power that slew the Kaimei Brain/　has no effect on me.
I should be on the righteous path...!
Am I, too, bound by the law of decline...?
You would defy the law of the heavens...!
Do you mean to fight the darkness for all eternity...?!
That I should return to darkness...!
Do you intend to revive the Kaimei Brain...?!
That power is as good as my gift to you.
Do you understand...?/　You are helping your nemesis return...!
You have not awakened the key's power.
That cannot be the twelfth key...!
Do not overrate your power. The same thing/　shall not happen twice.
This is... the power that slew my kin...?
You who cast away your power cannot slay me.
You shall never regain your power...!
How feeble, servant of darkness.
So you would use that power for humanity's sake.
Those you have taught shall never reach the Taiji.
Not you, who forgot your mission as a Hakam...!
You cannot violate my body.
A foolish move.
Do not despair. That feeds the Kaimei Brain.
My conclusion shall not change.
The righteous path has already been set.
A feeble resistance.
You know the deity ship's power well, surely.
The key cannot open a way out for you.
That such power slew my kin... I cannot believe it.
You should recognize the deity ship's power.
The power of darkness is useless against me.
Your mission is already over.
You erred in your teaching.
A foolish plan.
You cannot touch me.
That great strength is useless.
How feeble.
Scheming is futile.
Your fate shall not change.
Surely you do not cling to life now.
Certain death...
Receive my power.
Scatter like petals.
Be lost.
Breathe your last.
I pass judgment on you.
Perish without ever reaching the truth.
Disperse.
Be obliterated by the light that vanquishes evil.
Fire, Grandred Fenossa.
You shall not pass through this pure light.
Be destroyed. Die. Cease to be.
It is time for judgment.
Behold, the most sacred punishment.
Light Blade.
It is time to close the coffin.
I shall exterminate the transgressors.
Resistance is not permitted.
You are but the temporary form/　of an aggregate of dark thoughts...
Thus, I shall first eradicate/　the source that births the seven malices.
This is my conclusion.
Severing Strike.
Where there is light, there is darkness./　Where there is intelligent life, there is malice.
That which feeds the Kaimei Brain.../　I shall cut it off at its root.
